question.text: Long-term high-priority goals (e.g., retirement) are BEST funded through:

answer.text: Diversified portfolio across multiple asset classes

explanation.text: The Logic: Long-term high-priority retirement goals are usually funded through a diversified approach using several asset classes. The Trap: Single-asset strategies (overnight funds only, one stock, 100% gold) do not satisfy the diversification requirement for long-term goals. Note: Multi-asset diversification fits the long horizon and high priority of retirement-style goals.
